verdict.rationale: Supabase ships and documents an official MCP server (mcp.supabase.com) that lets AI assistants like Claude/Cursor connect and operate on Supabase projects, and hands-on probes confirm it's live and auth-gated. However, community evidence shows real security caveats — the assistant/service_role connection bypasses RLS and there have been prompt-injection exploits, which Supabase has only partially mitigated.
